name: playful-kawaii-pink-bedroom
image_purpose: UGC-style playful fashion and bedroom portrait

prompt.project_info: Create a realistic vertical UGC bedroom portrait of an original approved adult model with a colorful kawaii-inspired aesthetic.
prompt.main_subject: An original approved adult woman with long brown-blonde hair in high pigtails, colorful hair clips, cute stylized makeup, and a cheerful friendly smile sits on a bed while lightly holding one section of hair.
prompt.composition_elements: Direct eye contact, upper body slightly angled toward camera, pastel pink bedroom, lavender bedding, sheer curtains, a replaceable illustrated wall poster, sleeveless magenta graphic top, checkerboard lounge shorts with secure coverage, and soft orange ribbed arm warmers.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm soft ambient lighting with a pink tint, dreamy diffused curtains, cheerful playful kawaii-inspired mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Realistic lifestyle photography, vertical 2:3, slightly above eye level, natural skin texture, gentle depth of field, crisp but not overprocessed.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Realistic vertical UGC lifestyle portrait of an original approved adult woman with long brown-blonde hair in high pigtails and colorful hair clips, smiling directly at camera while seated on a bed and lightly holding her hair. She wears a sleeveless magenta graphic top, secure-coverage checkerboard lounge shorts, and soft orange ribbed arm warmers. Pastel pink bedroom, lavender bedding, sheer curtains, and a replaceable illustrated wall poster in the background. Warm diffused pink ambient lighting, cheerful kawaii-inspired energy, natural texture, 2:3.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, minor, childlike features, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, warped hands, unreadable text, watermark, copyrighted character dependence

assets.name: playful pink bedroom reference
assets.usage: Match the adult subject's hair, seated pose, colorful styling, bedroom palette, and portrait framing.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Keep identity, hairstyle, pose, outfit color story, room palette, and lighting consistent. Identity, outfit, product, logo, environment, and typography elements must be replaceable; replace recognizable character graphics and visible wording with approved editable alternatives when needed.
